Job Description

As part of the Arvato Group, we are seeking new team members for ATC Computer Transport & Logistics GmbH**, Hessenring 15L in 64546 Mörfelden-Walldorf. ATC is a global logistics, white-glove, and technical services specialist for data centres. For over 45 years, we've helped deliver Europe's data centres safely, securely, and right the first time. Our work includes specialist IT transport and relocations, as well as full data centre commissioning and decommissioning.

As a company within the Arvato Group, we benefit from the strength, scale, and global expertise of one of the world's leading supply chain and technology partners. What truly sets us apart, however, is our people. We invest in training, development, and continuous improvement, and we take pride in building long-term relationships with our clients and teams across Europe.

Data Centre Installers (DCIs) provide an essential service to our clients across Europe. They work inside our clients’ data centres delivering, positioning, and installing server racks to build their cloud infrastructure. Safety, security and customer service are the priorities for all ATC employees. Are you on it?

Your Responsibilities:

- Hardware Setup: Unloading, unpacking with power tools and positioning customers’ IT hardware (server racks). Cabling server racks by patching and dressing fibre and copper cables.
- Procedure Compliance: Following clients’ procedures and requirements, including health and safety, and security.
- Communication: Communicating with costumers, colleagues, managers, planners, team leaders and supervisors, in a consistent, timely, and efficient manner.
- Daily Reporting: Completing daily checklists and providing reports on daily activities or tasks.

Qualifications

- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with high levels of attention to detail
- Basic experience with hand and power tools
- Adaptability and responsiveness to evolving costumer requirements
- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams and Email
- Professional communications skills with clients, colleagues and vendors
- Language proficiency: C1 level in English and B2 level in German

Additional Information

jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

Your role:

You will support Controlling in producing company valuation models (DCF models) and will back the results with other valuation approaches. You will also organize and manage due diligence processes and will summarize the results. You will conduct negotiations and will work closely with both the legal department and external legal advisors to create the relevant legal documentation, taking into account the input from all the relevant specialist departments. Last but not least, you will prepare decision papers, present these to top management and coordinate key activities following the successful completion of transactions.

Who you are:

- Degree in business administration with specialization in finance or a university degree in another subject with an additional business qualification (e.g. MBA)
- At least five years of professional experience working in M&A at a company, at a Private Equity firm, in investment banking or in relevant fields within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical industries
- Experience in project management and ideally in an international environment
- Highly structured working style and analytical mindset
- Team-oriented and strong communication skills
- Ability to motivate teams
- Strong organizational skills and ability to cope with pressure
- Reliability and flexibility
- Willingness to travel on business
- Ability to conduct negotiations in English

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

As part of the “Potenziale strategisch entfalten” initiative within zukunft.niedersachsen, a joint funding program of the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture and the Volkswagen Foundation, University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) is receiving almost €20 million to further strengthen its research and innovation activities. The UMG2032 – Excellence through Focus project focuses on recruiting and establishing early-career research groups, as well as early-career postdoctoral positions. Moreover, the project supports measures to promote knowledge transfer, graduate training for medical students, the establishment of a Medical Career Center, and further specialization in securing funding from international third-party funding agencies.

The Research Management team of the UMG oversees all EU-funded and international research projects, providing comprehensive support from advising applicants and handling contract negotiations to monitoring approved projects. Additionally, we assist with applications for national grants. As part of our commitment to expanding UMG’s success in securing international funding, we are placing a particular focus on opportunities from the US and UK. To achieve this, we are creating a specialized position within our team to provide targeted support to UMG scientists, covering both the application process and project administration.

We are seeking an open-minded, native English-speaking professional to step into this exciting and impactful role.

Your Tasks

Providing independent advice and support to researchers throughout the application and management process for third-party-funded research projects, with a particular emphasis on complex international funding opportunities. This includes navigating the specific regulatory and legal frameworks of international funding bodies, thereby enhancing our capacity to secure international grants. Key responsibilities include:

- Analysis and assessment of application and funding requirements, with a focus on understanding and interpreting the intricate regulatory and legal frameworks essential for successfully securing and implementing projects funded by international bodies.
- Providing guidance and support to researchers in the preparation, design, and drafting of third-party funding applications, ensuring compliance with the specific requirements of the funding call (e.g., budgetary considerations, formalities, and alignment of project proposals with the objectives of the call).
- Conducting formal and substantive reviews of third-party funding applications to ensure compliance with both internal and external guidelines, and coordinating additional administrative processes in collaboration with relevant UMG administrative departments.
- Providing support for ongoing internationally funded projects, including tasks such as contract negotiations and preparation, amendment requests, compliance monitoring, and financial or scientific reporting. Support for ongoing internationally projects (e.g. contract preparations, amendment requests, reporting)
- Offering target-group-specific information and organizing events or workshops on international research funding opportunities and best practices.
- Contributing to the strategic development of the Research Management Office, including identifying and addressing key challenges in handling complex international funding schemes and increasing UMG's competitiveness in securing international grants.

This role requires a deep understanding of the regulatory, legal and administrative landscape of international funders, with a focus on translating these complexities into actionable guidance and strategic opportunities for our researchers. By bridging the gap between funding bodies requirements and researchers needs, you will play a key role in expanding UMG’s potential to successfully acquire and manage international research grants.

To support your success in this role, we highly encourage further professional development, including certification as a Research Administrator (e.g., through the Research Administrators Certification Council), to deepen your expertise in international grant management and funding processes.

Your qualifications

- Native English speaker
- A completed academic degree (Master’s or equivalent)
- Experience in academic management or in the administration of third-party-funded collaborative projects is an advantage
- Strong knowledge of international funding landscape, particularly in the US or UK, ideally supported by certified further training (e.g. Certified Pre-Award Administrator (CPRA®) or Research   Admin (CPA®))
- Basic understanding of interdisciplinary topics relevant to grant applications, such as research data management, open science, diversity/equality and the promotion of early-career researchers
- Effective communication skills in German, written and spoken (minimum B1 level)
- A high level of initiative, organizational skills and reliability under time pressure, combined with strong teamwork and flexibility

We offer

- Good working conditions within a dedicated and motivated team
- A varied role in an international environment
- Health and fitness supported by an excellent workplace health management program
- A comprehensive range of training and development opportunities (see also above)
- Remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement for the public sector in the federal states (TV-L), including public sector social benefits and supplementary pension provision

Application deadline is Sunday, 18th October 2026 before the end of the day. Informal inquires can be directed to Dr. Uschi Hübner (forschung@med.uni-goettingen.de), Head of Research Management.

jobs.occupation: Data Analytics, Data Science & AI Manager (D/F/M) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

As a Data Analytics, Data Science & AI Manager, you will lead the strategic transformation of complex operational data into cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics solutions. Operating at the intersection of supply chain execution, predictive engineering, and machine learning, you will drive the design and deployment of end-to-end data products, automated workflows, and enterprise AI models across the Procurement Operations Cabin Supply Chain and Quality environment. Bridging the gap between modern IT infrastructure and core business operations, you will serve as a key technical leader—fostering an AI-first, data-driven culture to optimize end-to-end performance and business excellence.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautical legacy.

Your benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA

Your tasks and responsibilities

- AI Strategy, Data Science & Predictive Analytics: Architect intelligent automation workflows and decision-support systems that embed AI directly into daily operational and procurement processes
- Data Architecture, Pipeline & Data Engineering Leadership: Ensure robust data governance, pipeline efficiency, and data quality standards across all analytics products
- Analytics Delivery, Stakeholder Management & Visualization: Serve as the primary technical interface and thought partner between operational business units, executive stakeholders, and the broader IT/Data engineering ecosystem
- Process Engineering & Operational Impact: Identify high-impact opportunities where advanced analytics, natural language processing, and computer vision/ML can drive process efficiency, cost reduction, and quality improvement

Your boarding pass

- Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field
- Deep expertise in Data Engineering / Data modeling and business intelligence tools (e.g., Skywise, Power BI, Tableau)
- Domain & Process Expertise: Proven track record leading data science initiatives within aerospace, automotive, supply chain, or complex manufacturing industries. Solid foundation in continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile/Scrum)
- Outstanding ability to articulate complex technical architectures, model outcomes, and AI capabilities to non-technical executive leadership and cross-functional teams
- ​Advanced proficiency in Python and production-grade SQL (skills in R or additional languages are a plus)
- Ideally, proven hands-on experience deploying Machine Learning algorithms, predictive analytics, or enterprise AI/LLM solutions in operational environments
- Languages: Fluency in English is required; German skills are beneficial

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Disabled applicants will be given preference in case of equal qualification.

Ready for take-off?

Apply now with your resume, salary expectations and notice period to take your career to the next level!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

The Leibniz Institute of Virology (LIV) is an independent research institution for basic biomedical research. As a foundation under civil law and member of the Leibniz Association, the institute occupies a leading position both nationally and internationally.

The Research Department Viral Zoonoses - One Health, headed by Prof. Dr. Gülşah Gabriel, investigates the interspecies transmission of influenza A viruses from animals to humans and the molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis in humans, particularly with regard to risk factors (pregnancy, obesity, and gender dependence). The department aims to identify and characterize viral and cellular determinants driving increased pathogenicity and transmissibility. These insights are further extended to other respiratory viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 and RSV, with particular attention to post-acute sequelae and their long-term impact. Ultimately, the knowledge gained will inform the development of novel antiviral strategies.

We are looking for a highly motivated, ambitious, and team-oriented candidate for a

Postdoc Position (f/m/x)
Conduct and shape a research project on the pathogenesis of respiratory virus infections under BSL-2 and BSL-3 conditions
Work as an independent researcher with accountability towards the research project
Preparation and submission of animal experimentation applications in compliance with regulatory requirements, including direct liaison with the relevant authorities to ensure timely approval
Integrate into the research team and provide support for junior members / students
Present research findings at national and international level
Develop future research projects and draft manuscripts

Solid expertise in virology or cell biology and experimental laboratory work
Experience in conducting animal experiments
Strong commitment, team spirit, very good communication and organizational skills, and ability to work in an independent and flexible manner
PhD degree in life sciences
Very good German and English language skills (oral and written)

Working as part of a highly motivated team in a state-of-the-art, international research environment with excellent core facilities
Remuneration according to EG 13 TV-AVH (Hamburg Employment Law Association Collective Agreement) (comparable to TVöD - Civil Service Collective Agreement), including company pension scheme
30 days of annual vacation
Opportunity to obtain FELASA C certification, providing the qualification to independently conduct animal experimentation
Further training opportunities, including subsidized English and German courses at the institute
Grant for unscheduled child care
Health protection offers at the institute (in cooperation with voiio GmbH)
Flexible, family-friendly working hours
HVV Deutschlandticket subsidy
Canteen use subsidy

The position is initially limited for two years with starting date January 1, 2027.

The LIV is certified with the TOTAL E-QUALITY distinction and promotes work-life balance and professional equality between employees of all genders. Severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration if their suitability, qualifications, and professional performance are otherwise equal.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer and smarter. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.8 billion euros. Continental's tire division currently employs around 53,000 people worldwide and has 19 production and 16 development sites.

Job Description

Kick-start your HR career with us! In our HR team in Hanover-Stöcken, you'll gain practical insights into talent development, employer branding, digitalization, and many other exciting HR topics.

Start as soon as possible in a 6-month internship. A combination of mandatory and voluntary internship periods is possible, and partial remote work can be arranged.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

- Work with an international network of HR and business stakeholders
- Drive your own tasks in global HR and talent development projects
- Help shape learning and development initiatives for employees worldwide
- Create impactful presentations and insightful analyses
- Support workshops, trainings, and global HR activities

Qualifications

- Students (m/f/diverse) in the field of Business Administration or comparable degree programs with a focus on Human Resource Management
- Initial experience or a strong interest in Human Resources
- Proficient in using the MS Office package (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
- Very good command of English, both written and spoken
- German language skills are a plus
- High level of commitment, creativity, and enjoyment of teamwork
- Structured way of working as well as strong initiative
- Enjoyment of communication in an international environment

Please attach your current certificate of enrollment and also your current transcripts of records and an extract of certificate for a mandatory internship. Those documents are mandatory for processing your application.

If required, please submit your valid residence permit as well as your work permit including the additional sheet.

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

We offer the following benefits:

- Fair compensation for your contribution: We know your work is valuable and want to make sure you are compensated fairly.
- Flexibility that fits your life: We offer flexible working hours with hybrid working models, giving you the opportunity to occasionally work from home – because we know how important the balance between personal and professional life is.
- Meaningful knowledge transfer: You will receive qualified support from our experienced professionals to develop your technical knowledge and practical skills.
- Saving made easy: Benefit from a wide range of discounts and special offers through our corporate benefits program, covering various brands – from fashion and leisure activities to technology products.
- Stay fit & healthy: We support you with initiatives focused on health and well-being, such as selected fitness and preventive care programs.
- More flavor, less cost: As a student, you receive an additional discount in our company cafeteria.
- A work environment that embraces diversity: Look forward to working in a diverse and international environment through collaboration with our global locations.

For more information about the employee benefits you can expect at Continental, please visit our benefits page (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/benefits/) . If you would like to learn more about our location, feel free to visit our site page: Continental Hannover Stöcken (https://www.continental.com/de/karriere/arbeiten-bei-continental/standorte/hannover-stoecken/) / Hannover Corporate Headquarters (https://www.continental.com/de/karriere/arbeiten-bei-continental/standorte/continental-unternehmenszentrale/) .

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/corporate-culture-values/diversity/) are important to us and make our company strong and successful. We offer equal opportunities to everyone - regardless of age, gender, nationality, cultural background, disability, religion, ideology or sexual orientation.

If this sounds like a perfect match for you and if you want to become the next supporter of our core values: Trust, for one another, passion to win and freedom to act - we are looking forward to receiving your application.
